title: Lipschitz approximation and graph criterion (Simon 5.2.6–5.2.7)
statement: For n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0 and C₆ ≥ 1 there are δ₅ ∈ (0, 1/8], 0 < β' ≤ β ≤ 1/4 and C₇ > 0 such that for every δ ∈ (0, δ₅] and all data satisfying (SA_δ): U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U; R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n; ξ_R = R.orient is its orientation, and ξ below denotes a point) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M; H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x; R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W; ρ > 0 with the closed ball B_ρ(z) ⊆ W; z ∈ spt μ; μ(B_ρ(z)) ≤ (1 + δ)ω_nρⁿ (ω_n = unitBallVolume n); κρ ≤ δ: for every ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{δρ}(z), σ₀ ∈ (0, δρ], L ∈ (0, 1] with δ^α ≤ βL (α := 1/(2n+2)) and every n-dimensional subspace T₀ with (i) ∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)} |p_x − p_{T₀}|² dμ ≤ C₆δ^{2α}σ₀ⁿ and (ii) |(x − ξ) − p_{T₀}(x − ξ)| ≤ C₆δ^ασ₀ for all x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀}(ξ), there are linear isometries ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 and ι(v) ∈ T₀ for all v, w, and f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ L|v − w| and |f(v)| ≤ C₇δ^ασ₀ for all v, w, such that, with F := {ξ + ιv + ι'f(v) : v ∈ ℝⁿ}: (5A) μ(B_{σ₀/2}(ξ) ∖ F) + Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_{σ₀/4}(ξ)) ≤ (C₇/L²)∫_{B_{σ₀}(ξ)} |p_x − p_{T₀}|² dμ; and (5B) if ∫_{B_t(y)} |p_x − p_{T₀}|² dμ ≤ β'²L²tⁿ for all y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/2}(ξ) and t ∈ (0, σ₀/2], then spt μ ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ) = F ∩ B_{σ₀/8}(ξ). Here p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x^⊥ := I − p_x, p_S the orthogonal projection onto a subspace S, |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum over EuclideanSpace.single i 1), B_t(y) the closed ball, and integrals of nonnegative functions are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (Lean ∫⁻ of ENNReal.ofReal).
